root_cause: The focus trap's delayInitialFocus option defaults to true, deferring initial focus until after the current event loop. When the dialog opens via Enter key, the assertion checking immediate focus on #street fails because focus hasn't moved yet.
repair_strategy: Pass { delayInitialFocus: false } to trap.activate() so initial focus occurs synchronously with dialog opening, matching the exact original source formatting.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users will now receive immediate focus on the first focusable element (street input) when the dialog opens, satisfying WCAG 2.4.3 (focus order) and 2.1.1 (keyboard).
functional_risks: Changing the timing of focus initialization could affect scenarios that rely on the delayed focus (e.g., if the dialog content is not yet ready). In this case the dialog is static and ready immediately, so risk is low.
verification_requirements: After activating the dialog, focus must be on #street input.
Pressing Enter after entering an address must save the address and update the status.
Pressing Escape must close the dialog and return focus to the #open button.
The speed fieldset must remain disabled until an address is saved.
